policies.consume: one stack per real stow transaction of this weapon; ready uses stacks without consuming

source.officialDescription: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.
source.ddcText: 198 Shot Swap On Weapon Kill : Grants 2 stacks of Shot Swap, up to a maximum of 6 stacks. Upon readying or stowing the weapon: Consumes a stack on stow. Grants +100 Ready/Stow Handling and 0.7x ↑0.65x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier.
source.scope: PvE base (non-enhanced); '?' values are not facts, see policies
